3196.title: Retention sweep blocks the server event loop
3196.rootCauseOneLine: Completed-output retention performs synchronous SQLite JSON work for a large batch without yielding or creating a blocking attribution frame.
3196.proposedFix: Run small attributed synchronous truncation steps, yield between them, retain the existing overall cap, and stop when scan progress shows no full step remains.
3196.caveats: The deterministic test reproduces event-loop starvation but does not recreate the exact multi-second delay or downstream HTTP failures from a private production database.
